“Transfer Pricing Officer” means any officer of Inland

“trustee” means an individual or body corporate holding
assets  in  a  fiduciary  capacity  for  the  benefit  of
identifiable persons or for some object permitted by
law and whether or not–

individuals or bodies corporate; or
